pages.raw_title: Buy a Home Online | Century Communities
pages.raw_meta: Discover how easy online home buying is! Now you can buy your new dream home online—from your couch, on the go, any time you choose.
raw_blocks: Start your new home journey today
in just a few easy steps

Our easy-to-use online homebuying experience lets you browse our extensive collection of stylish and modern homes online—then purchase from your computer or phone any time of day or night! With a versatile lineup of floor plans designed with your lifestyle in mind, the perfect home is waiting for you.
Discover the freedom of online homebuying with two renowned brands:
Our industry-first online homebuying process is now available on homes in all locations!
Click "Buy Now" on any available home
Fill out our buyer information form
Make it official with an initial deposit
Sign your contract via DocuSign ®
NICE JOB—YOU’RE ON YOUR WAY!
Now to work on a loan for your dream home with affiliate lender, Inspire Home Loans®
Finalize all forms and disclosures
Complete your prequalification and loan approval
Submit your remaining earnest money deposit

We pride ourselves on our commitment to quality, craftsmanship and customer satisfaction. That’s why we’re trusted by buyers from coast to coast and one of the nation’s largest homebuilders. So why wait? Start your journey today and discover the home of your dreams.
Go Ahead, Give It a Try
